summary: @servicetitan/form preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases` into a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a single-line ~711 KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, hex-mangled identifiers, string-array rotator `WV8StW`) whose contents cannot be inspected without execution. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute a bundled opaque payload at install time causes attacker-authored code to run on any host that runs `npm install` on this version, and the alternate-runtime choice evades Node-focused analysis. The behavior is unrelated to the package's stated purpose (a UI form library) and fires automatically before any consumer code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
